liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sketches Of Winkle** (1 review): Listener is delighted to be able to hear this song on demand from the recording [9]
- **Cocaine** (1 review): Played right after Bananas & Blow, a pairing the reviewer found unusual [13]
- **Tried & True* (dedicated to Steve McClellan from First Avenue)** (1 other source): Encore song dedicated to Steve McClellan of First Avenue, with Gene and Dean on acoustic guitars [1]
- **Help Me Scrape The Mucus Off My Brain** (1 other source): Played in the encore with Gene and Dean on acoustic guitars [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **Ice Castles**: back after 41 archived shows (658 days) [16]
- **band intro's**: back after 336 archived shows (3580 days); rare: 3 archived performances [16]
- **Cocaine**: rare: 4 archived performances [16]
- **encore Break pt. 1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [16]
- **encore Break/crowd noise/tuning pt. 2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [16]
- **Gene takes a pee**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [16]

## The recordings

- **ween2006-08-01.mbho603a.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 39 songs; 172 min [1]
- **Ween2006-08-01**: source not stated; 38 songs; 169 min [2]
- **ween2006-08-01.lsd2.flac16**: source not stated; 35 songs; 170 min; rated 4.85/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Listener finds the recording sounds pretty good even over ordinary computer speakers; Reviewer calls it the best live sound quality they have heard from Ween; Reviewer calls it the most incredible Ween audience recording they have heard [4][8][14]

## Around the show

- The encore was acoustic, which the reviewer singled out for praise [8]
- Band told the crowd beforehand that it would be a long set; reviewer stood in the front row [12]
- Reviewer says a third cocaine-themed song, Put the Coke on my Dick, would have made a hat trick [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2006-08-01.mbho603a.flac16**: taped by Dean Lambrecht; transferred by John Coughlin; source: MBHO MBP 603a + KA200N (DIN cards, Row G seat 13, FOB LOC, stand @ 7'^) > Hydra Silver XLR’s > UA5 (BM2p+ mod) > D7 (coax) & JB3 (opti) @44.1 kHz. [1]
- **Ween2006-08-01**: MBHO 603a with KA200N capsules, Row G seat 13, through UA5, D7 and JB3 to USB, WAV, FLAC, then CDR and EAC [2]
- **ween2006-08-01.lsd2.flac16**: taped by Steve Pzynski; transferred by Steve Pzynski; source: (FOB/LOC/row G) Studio Projects LSD2 [xy 90] > Edirol UA-5 [BM2p+ mod.] > iRiver iHP-120 [3]. Also: Reviewer notes the taper used a new microphone setup and turned the recording around quickly; Inspired by this recording, the reviewer plans to add a Studio Projects LSD2 microphone to their own taping rig [7][14]
